lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the left lateral torso. Spacing is narrowest at the anterior shoulder (approx. 40 pixels) and widens to its maximum at the mid-torso (approx. 90 pixels) before narrowing again at the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the anterior, splitting approximately 1/4 of the way down from the dorsal ridge. A secondary merging of two short segments is visible in the upper posterior quadrant near the 10th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 4, 7, and 9 exhibit truncation, terminating mid-torso and failing to reach the ventral hair fringe. Line 11 is present only as a short dorsal segment near the haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the mid-to-lower haunch. The spots are arranged in a loose trapezoidal formation above the transition to the tan-colored lower limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the lower posterior haunch align horizontally, forming a short geometric axis parallel to the ventral plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, emerging at an approximate 50-degree angle from the skull base and curving inward at the terminal third.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.7 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lower cheek/jaw area. A continuous white-tipped mane extends along the dorsal ridge from the neck to the base of the tail.
